messages:
alex kim: Heads-up: Sentinel Ops pinged us — they found a misconfigured bucket containing our ingestion logs. Possible API keys in logs. tagging @samir and @maria for triage.

sentinel-ops: Hey Redwood team — we discovered an S3 bucket (s3://sentinel-telemetry-logs-prod) with public list permissions between 2026-03-15 and 2026-03-16. We rotated any keys we found and started a lock-down. Sharing initial findings.

samir singh: on it. can you confirm which prefixes had access? any object names that look like our service names?

sentinel-ops: yes — prefix `redwood-inference/ingest/` had ~4k objects. Example keys: `redwood-inference/ingest/2026-03-15/ingest-1234-stdout.log`. We redacted and rotated tokens where we saw clear patterns (bearer, x-api-key).

maria gomez: thanks. first tasks: 1) confirm if any active keys belong to us, 2) identify scope (read vs write), 3) rotate if needed, 4) update alerting for vendor buckets. i'll coordinate comms.

elena taylor: samir — can you query our key-usage logs and KMS audit to see if any customer KMS CMKs were accessed from sentinel ip ranges during that window? If yes, initiate emergency CMK rotation and key-policy review.

samir singh: running queries now. quick note: if tokens were in plain logs, rotating service tokens + limiting RBAC is lowest friction. for CMKs, rotation is heavier, let's confirm access first.

devsecops-bot: alert: suspicious-s3-access detected -> 2026-03-15T11:22Z to 2026-03-16T03:14Z. Related IPs: 52.84.12.45, 18.204.33.90. Rule triggered: PUBLIC_OBJECT_LISTING.

samir singh: query results: 0 accesses to our customer CMKs from those IPs in CloudTrail for that timeframe. We did see 7 GetObject calls to S3 objects that contain our service names, but source IPs map to Sentinel's worker range (they confirmed worker misconfig).

maria gomez: good — lower blast radius on KMS. Next: rotate any API keys found in logs and enforce short-lived credentials for integrations. alex can you start a rotation for integration keys we own?

alex kim: starting rotation for the 3 integration keys that map to `ingest-proxy`. will deploy new creds via Secrets Manager and update infra to pick them up. ETA 45m. posting logs here when done.

sentinel-ops: we've applied a bucket policy to deny Public and List, and scoped access to sentinel service role only. still validating. we can provide an attachment with object list (redacted) if helpful.

elena taylor: request sent to infra: please add a deny statement for s3:ListBucket on any non-vendor roles for buckets prefixed with `sentinel-`. also add CloudTrail log-validation alert for public ACLs.

maria gomez: comms plan: 1) notify CS of limited customer exposure (we believe internal ingestion logs only), 2) prepare customer-facing note if we confirm any customer API key exfiltration, 3) backlog remediation: RBAC tightening, vendor onboarding checklist update, vendor KMS integration docs (use IRSA/assume-role patterns).

samir singh: remediation checklist I'm adding to the incident board: - completed rotation of ingest-proxy keys - add short-lived STS role for sentinel integration - update bucket policies + S3 block public access - add CloudWatch alarm for large object listing operations - run a search for token patterns across archival buckets

alex kim: rotation complete. updated secrets and restarted ingest-proxy in staging then canaryed to prod. no errors observed in 10m. keys invalidated for old creds.

sentinel-ops: thanks. we'll do a post-mortem and share our vendor-side mitigation steps and timeline.

elena taylor: follow-up items for security team: 1) add vendor buckets to our external-bucket monitoring list, 2) run a full grep for patterns `Bearer [A-Za-z0-9-_.]+` across ingested logs (we'll use an isolated scanner), 3) update vendor onboarding checklist to mandate server-side encryption with AWS KMS and role-based access only.

maria gomez: assigning owners: samir -> forensic logs search, elena -> infra policy changes, alex -> secrets rollout verification, me -> comms and tracking. can everyone ack? :thumbsup:

samir singh: ack

elena taylor: ack

alex kim: ack

maria gomez: we'll keep this thread for status. once sentinel posts their post-mortem we can link it and close. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
